site.name: pulsegrid
site.summary: PulseGrid Fictional bulk-power-system SCADA / EMS dashboard "PulseGrid" for the Western Interconnect. UXBench fixture in the Dashboard category. Pages - `index.html` — **Overview**. Left rail nav (6 entries with alarm badge); top bar with BA selector (Western / ERCOT / SPP / MISO), Production / Replay / Plan tabs, live ticking clock, ⌘K, theme toggle, alert bell, operator avatar; 5 KPI cards (demand / generation / frequency / renewables share / active alarms) each with sparkline; **2-column body grid**: 48-hour load chart with actual / forecast (dashed) / net renewables area + "NOW" marker, weather card with 4 zones (Phoenix 112°F driving 1.8 GW cooling load, Tehachapi wind, etc.), 24-cell generator status grid (color-coded online / tripped / ramping / maintenance with output + % capacity), active-alarms list with severity dots (critical pulses), live fuel-mix bars (7 fuels), interchange table with 6 tie-lines (sched / actual / Δ). - `generators.html` — **Generator list** (38 units across the fleet). Filter strip with status pills (All / Online / Ramping / Tripped / Maintenance), fuel and zone selectors, and search. Sortable-style table with EMS ID, plant name, fuel-color icon, zon

run_plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full pulsegrid SCADA dashboard, ensuring all interactive widgets, data tables, and filtering mechanisms function correctly across different pages.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will start on the primary Overview dashboard, testing key widgets like the load chart and generator status toggles. It will then proceed systematically through the main adjacent flows: Alarms management, Generators directory, and Forecast details, interacting with specific filters and controls on each. Finally, it will verify global layout consistency, top bar controls (including theme toggles), and responsive behavior on mobile.
assumptions: The 'Topology' and 'Events' navigation links point to '#' and are likely placeholders.
Data filtering on the Alarms and Generators pages is client-side or mocked, allowing for instant feedback.
The ⌘K (command palette) and ☾ (theme toggle) buttons should have global effects or popups.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets across navigation items and filter pills (flagged in prescan)
Missing accessible labels on critical dropdowns (like the BA selector)
Horizontal scrolling and layout breakage of large data tables (Alarms, Generators) on mobile viewports
Visibility and feedback of state changes (e.g., acknowledging an alarm)

phases.title: Dashboard Overview
phases.objective: Validate the primary overview page widgets and top-level controls.
key_checks: Toggle the Load Chart timespans (24h, 48h, 7d)
Toggle the Generator status pills in the dashboard widget (Online, Tripped, Maintenance)
Change the BA selector dropdown and verify if it triggers a view update
Toggle between Production, Replay, and Plan modes
Click the theme toggle (☾) and check for visual changes
exit_criteria: All dashboard interactive elements have been exercised and any state changes or lack thereof recorded.

phases.title: Alarms Management
phases.objective: Test the filtering and actioning of system alarms.
key_checks: Navigate to Alarms via the left rail or dashboard widget link
Change the Severity, Status, and Time dropdown filters
Enter text into the search input
Select an alarm checkbox and click 'Acknowledge selected'
Click an individual 'Open →' button on an alarm row
exit_criteria: Alarm filtering combinations tested and alarm action buttons clicked.

phases.title: Generators Directory
phases.objective: Evaluate the grid layout and multifaceted filtering of generators.
key_checks: Navigate to Generators page
Click through the status filter pills (All, Online, Ramping, Tripped, Maintenance)
Change the Fuel and Zone dropdown selects
Type in the 'Search by name, plant, or EMS ID' input
Click a 'Details →' link for a specific generator
exit_criteria: Generator list filters successfully applied and interactions logged.

phases.title: Forecast View
phases.objective: Check the forecast charts and data presentation.
key_checks: Navigate to the Forecast page
Change the forecast model dropdown (Day-ahead, Hour-ahead, Real-time)
Toggle the chart timespan buttons (12h, 24h, 7d)
Attempt to click/tap a row in the Hourly breakdown table (as hinted by 'tap a row to overlay on chart')
exit_criteria: Forecast controls exercised and table interactivity verified.

phases.title: Global Navigation & Mobile Resilience
phases.objective: Ensure all navigation paths are tested, including edge cases, and evaluate mobile responsiveness.
key_checks: Click the 'Topology' and 'Events' links to confirm behavior (expected to stay on page or no-op)
Click the ⌘K button to see if a search modal appears
Switch to mobile viewport mode
Verify if the left rail navigation collapses into a hamburger menu and can be opened
Check horizontal scrolling or responsive stacking on the Alarms and Generators tables
exit_criteria: All main nav links clicked, command palette tested, and critical screens viewed in mobile dimensions.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 4 functional HTML pages (index, alarms, generators, forecast).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise filtering (selects, inputs, pill buttons) on list pages, chart timespan toggles, and global top bar controls.
coverage_targets.mobile: Ensure the complex data tables (Generators, Alarms) and main navigation are assessed in the mobile viewport.

notes: Many UI controls on this dashboard appear to be custom small tap targets. Pay attention to usability issues related to clicking these closely packed elements, especially in mobile mode.
